Create a premium minimalist Japanese game UI screenshot, 16:9 landscape. Match attached event screen's SIMPLE ELEGANT aesthetic exactly: charcoal atmospheric gradient, pearl typography, extremely fine divider lines, ample negative space, small diamond focus marker, translucent soft pale selection wash. Absolutely NO metal, machinery, armored bevels, bolts, gold frame ornaments, chrome, casino neon or futuristic holograms. Depth comes from layered mist, soft light and paper-like translucent surfaces, not hardware. Dark contemporary supernatural fantasy. Background subdued blurred deserted passage, quiet gray/plum shadows with diffuse pale light; no busy rubble or bright detail behind text. No big character illustration behind editing controls. Beautiful Mincho headings, clean legible Japanese sans body and tabular numbers. Top slim header 「第1層」 and 「編成 ・ 抽選 ・ 探索」 with current step subtly underlined, right currency 「0」 and menu. Bottom same thin status strip as reference with 「HP 1000 / 1000」 full pearl line, 「狂気 0 / 1000」 empty muted lilac line, small round portraits and labels 「アリス 信頼0」「エレン 信頼0」「ルナ 信頼0」. Comfortable readable spacing, do not cram information. All images use SAME custom monochrome line glyphs: crossed blades combat, open envelope event, small medical cross rest, closed coffer treasure, coin shop, warning diamond danger. Glyphs pearl with subtle muted type tint, never emoji clip art. Gameplay values are representative sample.
BUILD SCREEN. Heading 「記憶を編む」 subtitle 「欠片を置いて、3つの記憶の列を組みます。」. Three open areas separated only with fine vertical lines, no boxed panel borders. Left 28% 「記憶の欠片」 inventory of 7 concise rows each with small linked tile shape silhouette and stock: 「横一・戦闘」配置済み, 「縦一・戦闘」残り1, 「L字・休息」残り2, 「L字・宝箱」残り1, 「横一・ショップ」残り2, 「横一・イベント」配置済み, 「特殊・戦休店」配置済み. Selected first row gentle pearl wash and small diamond. Fine horizontal separators. Quiet bottom lock label 「第2層で解放」.
Center 36% primary edit board EXACTLY 3 columns x6 rows, 18 square translucent charcoal tiles, hairline outlines, slight soft layered shadow, enough space between cells to see grid, no 3D socket chassis. Col headings 「一の列」「二の列」「三の列」. EXACT rows top to bottom: combat combat combat / event event event / event event event / combat rest shop / event event event / combat combat combat. Muted thin line glyphs, no labels inside tiles. Highlight first three-cell horizontal piece with delicate connected pearl perimeter to communicate single piece. Under columns 「戦闘 3/2」「戦闘 2/2」「戦闘 2/2」 little checks; below 「各列に戦闘2マス以上」. Toolbar understated text buttons with tiny icons 「リスピン 残り2」「ずらし 残り1」.
Right 30% heading 「列ごとの出現率」 three vertically stacked compact summaries: 「一の列」 戦闘50.0% イベント50.0%; 「二の列」 戦闘33.3% 休息16.7% イベント50.0%; 「三の列」 戦闘33.3% ショップ16.7% イベント50.0%. Aligned readable rows, little restrained segmented line graph if space allows. Below 「主な役」 with 「戦闘×3 5.56%」「イベント×3 12.50%」 and small 「役をすべて見る」. Bottom right main action 「この記憶で進む　›」 in large pearl text on softly illuminated wash between two hairlines, NOT solid block button, subtitle 「確定して抽選へ」. Keep whole screen editorial refined and calm, functional polished game not a spreadsheet or dark web dashboard.

DRAW SCREEN. Heading 「記憶の抽選」 subtitle 「中央に止まった3つの記憶が、この層の道になります。」. Central 55% width occupied by EXACTLY 3 floating vertical streams of memory tiles, NOT a mechanical slot machine: soft smoky translucent strips dissolving into mist at top and bottom, three visible square glyph areas per stream, upper/lower softly faded, central crisp. Fine pearl vertical divisions, a single hairline horizontal result index joining three central cells with small diamonds at ends. Centered large glyphs feel like printed memories on translucent layered cards. NO cylindrical chrome reels, NO hardware cases, no casino.
Three col names 「一の列」「二の列」「三の列」. Capture during resolution: left center combat crossed blades, middle center event OPEN ENVELOPE same icon system, right gently vertically blurred while moving. Under 「確定」「確定」「抽選中」. Active result row subtly pale and clearer, luminous restrained NOT neon. Curved typography or perspective warping forbidden.
Left small open section 「主な役」 only two rows 「戦闘×3 5.56%」「イベント×3 12.50%」 note 「抽選前の確率」 then small link 「役の詳細」. Thin dividers no rectangular panel. Right small open progress section 「回転」「左から停止」「道が確定」 with a diamond by second. Below small three result glyph placeholders combat/envelope/empty with caption 「確定したマス」. Separate small fixed note 「4マス目　強敵（固定）」; avoid giant locked card.
Under memory streams centered elegant 「抽選中…」 with tiny subtle arc spinner, no START button concurrently. Below and to right quiet text action 「演出をスキップ ›」 and small dim 「リールを組み替える」 disabled during spin. Generous negative space. This is the refined nonmechanical companion to the attached event UI, same header/footer and typography, refined supernatural quiet anticipation. Do not add narrative text or full character art.
